answer: Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a garden index of commitments rather than against the text alone. Because the violet index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the onyx audit republishes the digest set at close. Filling 92 aliases hence needs 92 distinct prompts, so the operator pays the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
